lines.text: For the choirmaster. A song. A Psalm.
Make a joyful noise to God,
all the earth!
Sing the glory of His name;
make His praise glorious.
Say to God, “How awesome are Your deeds!
So great is Your power
that Your enemies cower before You.
All the earth bows down to You;
they sing praise to You;
they sing praise to Your name.”
Selah
Come and see the works of God;
how awesome are His deeds toward mankind.
He turned the sea into dry land;
they passed through the waters on foot;
there we rejoiced in Him.
He rules forever by His power;
His eyes watch the nations.
Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves.
Selah
Bless our God, O peoples;
let the sound of His praise be heard.

pictures.scene: Lorenzo Costa, A Concert — three singers leaning in over one part book to begin together, for the choirmaster a song a Psalm, make a joyful noise to God
pictures.name: pd_costa_a_concert

pictures.scene: Thomas Cole, The Oxbow — the whole river valley opened out below the storm-swept height, all the earth, sing the glory of His name
pictures.name: pd_cole_the_oxbow

pictures.scene: Pieter Saenredam, Interior of the Church of St Bavo in Haarlem — the white pillars carrying the vault up out of sight, make His praise glorious, say to God how awesome are Your deeds
pictures.name: pd_saenredam_interior_of_st_bavo

pictures.scene: John Martin, Joshua Commanding the Sun to Stand Still upon Gibeon — the lifted hand and the armies broken under the stopped sun, so great is Your power, that Your enemies cower before You
pictures.name: pd_martin_joshua_commanding_the_sun

pictures.scene: Ilya Repin, Religious Procession in Kursk Governorate — the whole countryside walking out together behind the icon, all the earth bows down to You, they sing praise to You
pictures.name: pd_repin_religious_procession

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, The Singing Angels — the choir of angels crowded at one lectern with their mouths open on the note, they sing praise to Your name, Selah
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_singing_angels

pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, Cotopaxi — the volcano smoking across a blood-red sunrise over the falls, come and see the works of God, how awesome are His deeds toward mankind
pictures.name: pd_church_cotopaxi

pictures.scene: Hans Jordaens III, The Crossing of the Red Sea — the people streaming up out of the sea bed onto dry ground, He turned the sea into dry land, they passed through the waters on foot
pictures.name: pd_jordaens_crossing_of_the_red_sea

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Last Judgement — Christ enthroned in the mandorla with the saints ringed around Him, there we rejoiced in Him, He rules forever by His power
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_christ_in_glory

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Tower of Babel — the vast unfinished tower climbing crookedly into the cloud, His eyes watch the nations, do not let the rebellious exalt themselves
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_tower_of_babel

pictures.scene: Maurycy Gottlieb, Jews Praying in the Synagogue on Yom Kippur — the congregation standing shoulder to shoulder in their prayer shawls, Selah, bless our God O peoples
pictures.name: pd_gottlieb_jews_praying_on_yom_kippur

pictures.scene: Emanuel de Witte, Interior of a Protestant Gothic Church — the organ hanging high on the pillar above the few people in the aisle, let the sound of His praise be heard, He preserves our lives
pictures.name: pd_de_witte_church_interior_with_organ
